title: Australian Meat Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole made with Australian beef and vegetables, perfect for a cold night.

ingredients.name: Australian beef mince
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free seasoning blend for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chop the onion finely before cooking.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic before adding it to the pan.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop the carrots into bite-sized pieces.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Peel and chop the potatoes into bite-sized pieces.

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free tomato paste for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Beef broth
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free beef broth for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Gluten-free tomato sauce
ingredients.notes: Choose a gluten-free tomato sauce for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Gluten-free pasta
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free pasta for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Shredded cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: Use a gluten-free cheddar cheese for this recipe.

instructions: Cook the gluten-free pasta according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large pan, cook the Australian beef mince over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth and gluten-free tomato sauce, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the cooked gluten-free pasta and shredded cheddar cheese until melted and well combined.
Transfer the casserole mixture to a baking dish and top with additional shredded cheddar cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
